name: Rack Pull
summary: A deadlift from pins or blocks around knee height that loads the upper back, traps and hips with heavy weights and a shorter range.
setup: Set the safety pins so the bar rests just below or at knee height.
Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip just outside the legs.
Pull the slack out of the bar, set the shoulder blades down and brace with a flat back.
execution: Push the floor away and drive the hips forward.
Keep the bar close to the legs as you stand tall.
Squeeze the glutes and upper back at lockout without leaning back.
Lower the bar under control back to the pins.
cues: Stand tall, do not lean back
mistakes: Rounding the back: lower the weight and brace before every pull.
Hitching the bar up the thighs or leaning back at lockout: finish by squeezing the glutes only.
Bar drifting away from the body: keep it in contact with the legs.
Dropping the bar on the pins: control the descent.
